Method of Attack: Deploying a malicious filesystem using Linux PRoot utility to run a cryptominer
Using a preconfigured malicious filesystem to mine cryptocurrency using the host's GPU
Attack Vector: Downloading and mounting a malicious filesystem on compromised Linux machines using PRoot
Executing the XMRig binary within the mounted malicious filesystem
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of XMRig cryptominer and configuration files in the malicious filesystem
Filesystem dropped from trusted cloud hosting services like DropBox
